newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Southern Peru cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Southern Peru cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analysts Mauricio Reveco and Harald Liberge said Monday they had cut their rating on Southern Peru Copper Corp to hold from buy.

-- "We expect that a sustained decrease in the realized price for copper, combined with an aggressive capital expenditure program, will translate to SPCC's projected 1997 earnings (underperforming) those of 1996," they wrote in a report.
-- "However, we estimate that a sustained efficiency improvement in SPCC's operations would allow the company to maintain relatively strong cash flows within a weaker price environment."
-- Southern Peru shares were off 1/8 to 16-5/8 in New York.
